verdict.rationale: Edge0 documents a public, OpenAI-compatible HTTP API: `edge0 serve` exposes `/v1/chat/completions`, with a curl example. It also offers a transformers-style Python API (`AutoEngine.from_pretrained`, `AutoModel`/`AutoConfig`), so agents and scripts can drive it programmatically. The evidence is only README-level snippets, not a dedicated API reference. Missing for 10: a full API reference (parameters, other endpoints such as models/embeddings, auth and error behavior), and independent or hands-on corroboration that the endpoint works as documented.
